 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Deni Avdija and the Portland Trail Blazers host Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs on Saturday during the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 On Wednesday, in San Antonio's 112-111 victory over Cooper Flagg and the Dallas Mavericks, center Wembanyama had one of the best performances of the year, putting up 52 points on 16-for-28 shooting from the field, along with hauling in 24 rebounds. The 24 rebounds lead the league for an individual so far during the 2026-27 NBA regular season. The 52 points tie Luka Doncic of the Los Angeles Lakers for a season high.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Spurs vs Trail Blazers TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 San Antonio Spurs center Victor Wembanyama (1).Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images
 Time: 10 p.m. ET
 Venue: Moda Center, Portland
 TV: DirecTV, NBA League Pass, KUNP 16, DAZN SAS, BlazerVision
 Live stream: NBA League Pass through Amazon Prime Video
 Fans can watch the game for free through various avenues. One option is Amazon Prime, where users can sign up for a seven-day free trial of NBA League Pass. Another option is DraftKings Sportsbook, which offers a three-month free trial. Users must submit a minimum deposit of $5. Another way for fans to watch for free is through DirecTV. Users can subscribe to DirecTV with a free-trial subscription that can be canceled before five days.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Both teams are entering the game playing back-to-backs, with the Trail Blazers facing the Lakers on Friday and the Spurs facing the Kings
 For San Antonio, forward Tobias Harris is out with a calf injury and forward Jayden Quaintance is out with a knee injury. For Portland, guard Vit Krejci (leg), guard Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee) are all out for the game.
